heroHeadline: Day 712: Sheinbaum Leads Niños Héroes Ceremony at Chapultepec, Heads to Hidalgo After Closing Yucatán Leg of Report Tour
heroSubtitle: September 13, 2026 marks Day 712 of Claudia Sheinbaum's presidency. As commander-in-chief, she led the ceremony marking the 179th anniversary of the 1847 defense of Chapultepec Castle at the Altar a la Patria in Mexico City, where Defense Secretary Ricardo Trevilla Trejo pledged the Armed Forces' "absolute loyalty" and cadets fired a rifle salute honoring the six Niños Héroes; she then traveled to Pachuca, Hidalgo to continue her "Honestidad y Resultados" report tour. The previous day, September 12, she presented her Yucatán accountability report in Mérida — citing 781,215 residents receiving welfare-program benefits worth more than 17 billion pesos, 244 new primary-care clinics, the O'Horán hospital's IMSS-Bienestar expansion, a new 518MW power plant, and 36.6 billion pesos for the Tren Maya cargo line's first stage — the tour's 16th stop and midpoint ahead of its September 27 close in Mexico City. That followed September 10, when Sheinbaum rebuffed U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio's claim that Mexico has "ungoverned territories" controlled by cartels, calling it U.S. midterm-election rhetoric and citing a 53% drop in the daily homicide average since October 2024.
